description: Explicit allowlist for Microsoft source families that remain Missing only because their product responsibility is deliberately deferred beyond the already-completed Rust ownership slices. Any effective Missing contract outside this list fails the global inventory gate.

sources.reason: DOSKEY alias storage and macro expansion remain unported.
Full console API/global-state behavior remains native aggregate backlog.
Only the two CopyRequest/GetPlainText extraction contracts remain unported; keyboard/platform methods are separately Platform-only.
Command history allocation, resize, duplicate policy and persistence remain unported.
Input queue/coalescing/wait and DBCS stream behavior remain unported.
No safe Rust screen-buffer aggregate owns the complete cursor/viewport/renderer/selection/API coordination surface.
The C++ iterator operator API has no direct migrated Rust product abstraction.
Console title environment unexpansion/path translation remains unported.
TerminalApp JSON utility behavior has not transferred to a Rust product owner.
Terminal application command-line behavior remains native product logic.
Filtered-command product action semantics remain native.
TerminalApp settings integration remains native product logic.
